messages.text: One range test is failing. Fix the cause. Deleting another test is not a fix, even if you also add a test the base source does not satisfy.

The "single" test expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`, but the current implementation splits on `-` which for a single number gives `[from="7", to=undefined]`, making `to` become `NaN`. The fix is to handle the case where there's no hyphen.

response.text: The fix was to handle the single-number case in `parseRange`. When the input has no hyphen (e.g., `"7"`), it now returns `{ from: 7, to: 7 }` instead of producing `{ from: 7, to: NaN }`. Both tests now pass.
